en.name: Soy meat substitutes, frozen
en.summary: Frozen soy meat substitutes keep 12–18 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Keep them frozen and cook as directed. Once cooked, they keep 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: No room-temperature storage. Being plant-based changes nothing about how these behave in a warm kitchen: they are moist, low-acid, high-protein foods, and bacteria grow on them as readily as on meat. Anything left out is in the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) and follows the two-hour rule, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Take out what you will cook and reseal the bag straight away.
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once cooked, covered, and that is what the figure describes. A thawed but uncooked pack should be used within a day or so, sealed, on a low shelf. Reheat right through to steaming hot rather than to lukewarm; reheating a plant-based patty gently to warm is the same mistake as doing it with a meat one.
en.freezer: 12–18 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Kept continuously at −18 °C they stay safe indefinitely — that window is about quality, not safety. What goes wrong is the added vegetable oil oxidising, which gives an over-kept pack a stale, cardboardy taste, and freezer burn drying the surface into pale, crumbly patches. Press the air out of the bag and reseal tightly each time, and keep it away from the freezer door.
en.thawing: Most products cook straight from frozen, which is both quickest and best. If you need to thaw, do it in the fridge, never on the counter. A pack thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be refrozen with some quality loss; anything thawed warm must not be refrozen.
spoilage: A stale, cardboardy or painty smell from the oil — the usual failure mode.
Dry, pale, crumbly patches — freezer burn.
A slimy or sticky surface on a thawed product, which means it goes out.
A solid welded block or heavy ice in the bag, meaning it part-thawed and refroze.
tips: Cook from frozen where the pack allows it.
Reseal tightly with the air pressed out; the oil is what ages.
Label the bag with the date you opened it.
Reheat right through — plant-based does not mean lower risk.

faq.q: How long do frozen meat substitutes last?
faq.a: 12–18 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Kept continuously frozen they stay safe beyond that, but the oil in them goes stale.

faq.q: Do vegetarian meat substitutes need the same handling as meat?
faq.a: Yes. They are moist, low-acid and high in protein, so they sit in the danger zone exactly the same way and must be kept cold and reheated properly.

zh.name: 冷凍大豆素肉
zh.summary: 冷凍大豆素肉在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可保有最佳品質 12～18 個月。請保持冷凍並依指示烹調。煮熟之後放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫保存這一項。「植物做的」完全不會改變它在溫暖廚房裡的行為：它同樣含水量高、低酸、高蛋白，細菌長起來和肉一樣順利。任何擺在外面的都在 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶裡，適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。要煮多少拿多少，拿完馬上把袋子封回去。
zh.fridge: 煮熟之後蓋好放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，這個數字描述的正是這個狀態。已經解凍但還沒煮的那包請在一天左右內用掉，密封好放在下層。回熱要熱到中心冒熱氣，不要只是溫溫的；把植物素排「溫一下」和把肉排溫一下是同一個錯誤。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下自購買日起 12～18 個月品質最好。全程維持在 −18 °C 就一直是安全的——這個期限講的是品質，不是安全。真正出問題的是添加的植物油氧化，會讓放過頭的那包吃起來走味、有紙板味；再加上凍燒把表面弄成乾白、一碰就碎的斑塊。每次用完都壓出空氣、確實封緊，並遠離冷凍櫃門。
zh.thawing: 多數產品可以從冷凍直接煮，那也最快、最好。真的需要解凍就放冷藏，絕對不要放檯面。在冷藏解凍、且維持在 4 °C 以下的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折；回溫過的絕對不行。
spoilage: 油脂發出走味、紙板味或油漆味——最常見的結局。
出現乾燥、發白、一碰就碎的斑塊——那是凍燒。
解凍後表面黏滑或黏手，那就該丟。
整包凍成硬塊或結厚冰，表示曾經半退冰又再凍。
tips: 包裝允許就從冷凍直接煮。
每次都壓出空氣封緊；會老化的是油脂。
要熱透——素的不代表風險比較低。

faq.a: −18 °C 下自購買日起 12～18 個月品質最好。只要沒退冰放更久仍然安全，但裡面的油脂會走味。

faq.q: 素肉需要和真肉一樣小心處理嗎？
faq.a: 需要。它含水高、低酸又高蛋白，在危險溫度帶裡的表現完全一樣，同樣要冷藏保存、確實復熱。

faq.q: 煮熟的素肉冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋好放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天。
